# Search Console MCP

> Open-source MCP server for Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, GA4, CrUX, IndexNow and public-page SEO audits.

Search Console MCP exposes structured search data to Claude, Codex and other compatible MCP clients. Google and Bing metrics remain separate. An accepted submission proves neither crawl nor indexation.
